source_title: A strong man supporting a weak and emaciated woman; representing the work of the Zonnestraal sanatorium for the tuberculous. Colour lithograph by A. Hahn, 1932.
source_description: A fund-raising poster for the Zonnestraal ("Sunbeam") sanatorium for the tuberculous in Hilversum, founded in 1928 by the diamond merchant Jan van Zutphen, originally for tuberculous people working in the diamond industry. The phrase "De sterken voor de zwakken" (the strong for the weak) appears on much of the sanatorium's literature: it is symbolized by the strong man and the weak woman in the present design by Hahn Jr.
source_notes: 25 Juni A.S. Nationale Zonnestraaldag. De sterken voor de zwakken tegen de tuberculose. Hahn Jr. Offsetdruk Flach.

source_title: Tuberculosis patients lying on their beds in a crowded tuberculosis hospital; advertising a tombola in aid of tuberculosis sufferers in L'Hérault, France. Colour lithograph, ca. 1933.
source_description: Top, a roundel showing tuberculosis patients lying on their beds in a crowded TB hospital, with the windows wide open at night. Top right, the sun coming out through the clouds. Below, the text describes the distress of tuberculosis, which brings an end to the joys of life. Cure is possible, but it is tedious and demoralising. An appeal is made to the public to support the lottery organized by, and for, the tuberculous patients of the Bellevue and Bon Accueil sanatoriums of L'Hérault. The prizes include 1933 models of a Peugeot car and a Peugeot motorcycle
source_notes: De l'oubli! Pour les tuberculeux ... Grande tombola au profit des tuberculeux des sanatoriums de l'Hérault (Bellevue and Bon Accueil) ... l'œuvre est belle, les lots sont beaux: souscrivez!!! Le Comité

source_title: Thoracoplasty and apicolysis for pulmonary tuberculosis.
source_description: Shot in Cape Town, South Africa, this film was originally silent with a voice-over sound track added later. The film shows the surgical resection of three ribs and apicolysis followed by resection of four ribs and apicolysis. Post operative physiotherapy is then shown; the patient is shot with his back to camera exercising outside with a nurse. Supplemented by medical animated diagrams and x-ray shots. The intertitles were added and contextualise the surgical approach treatment; effective drug treatments were available not long after this film was originally made. 1 segment.
source_notes: 1 encoded moving image (34:57 min.) : sound, colour.
source_subjects: Physical Therapy Specialty; Therapeutics, Physiological; Thoracoplasty; Tuberculosis
